Patient, Customer, and Consumer Centricity Risk
The Company prioritizes a strong attention on the requirement and wellbeing of the patients, customers and consumers as the regulations gets more enhanced.

• The Company’s commitment to prioritizing patients, customers, and consumers is core principles of Knowledge, Action, Care and Impact. • The Company has implemented several initiatives to enhance engagement and improve outcomes with patient centricity at the top of its strategic priorities.
Potential positive implication due to customers’ trust and long- term strategic partnership.

• MBL’s capacity to satisfy patient needs, generate value, and establish trust with stakeholders is directly linked to the quality and safety of its products. • Inadequate performance in these critical domains can have negative consequences on stakeholders and, ultimately, on the business itself.

• MBL is on the track of enhancing its quality, transitioning from a focus on ‘Quality for Compliance’ to fostering ‘Quality as a Culture.’ This shift encompasses a holistic approach, including systems, processes, technology, and people. • A dedicated Corporate Quality Assurance Group consistently monitors adherence to prescribed product quality standards. • To excel in product quality, the Company implemented an internal strategy that includes the evaluation of the cost of poor quality, aiming for ‘first-time right’ outcomes.
Potential positive implications of maintaining high product quality and a quality-focused culture include fostering customer loyalty and building long-term strategic partnerships.
